variant_desc: {scale, qs[32]} per block (36B stride) -> {scales[8], qs[32][8]} super-block with transposed quants for 8-lane SIMD (variant 2: seed=44, n_scale=1.5x)
novelty_rationale: Tests recognition that interleaving 8 quantized blocks at the quant-index level (qs[i][k] over 8 blocks) yields a unit-stride SIMD load and an 8-lane vector accumulator, instead of a 36-byte-stride per-block scan. Compilers cannot perform this transformation because it requires reorganizing the on-disk GGUF model file format and re-arranging quant byte order across block boundaries.
